shortDescription.default: HKIS Teaching & Learning Handbook experience for the Curriculum site (toolbar, sidebar nav, themes, glossary tooltips, search). Activates only on /SitePages/Home1.aspx.

longDescription.default: Two Application Customizers that progressively enhance the HKIS Teaching & Learning Handbook page (Home1.aspx) on the Curriculum site. Adds a fixed toolbar, anchor-driven sidebar navigation, light/sepia/dark themes, FAQ collapsibles, pull-quote callouts, restyled Quick-Start CTA tiles, content search, and glossary-term hover tooltips driven by the site's Glossary list. URL-guarded to one page only — no impact on other content on the site.
